about: rp's seccomp program (sandbox._seccomp_program), as hex: 8 bytes per classic BPF instruction, little endian; and the proxy launcher (LAUNCHER_ARGV, _LAUNCHER, HANDOVER_TIMEOUT in seconds)

cases.name: launcher
cases.code:
import os, signal, socket, sys
fd, argv = int(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[3:]
try:
    pair = socket.socket(fileno=fd)
    lis = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    lis.bind(('127.0.0.1', 3128))
    lis.listen(128)
    socket.send_fds(pair, [b"L"], [lis.fileno()])
    go = pair.recv(1)
    lis.close()
    pair.close()
except OSError as e:
    sys.stderr.write("rpctl: network launcher failed: %s\n" % e)
    sys.exit(125)
if go != b"G":
    sys.stderr.write("rpctl: the client did not take the proxy port\n")
    sys.exit(125)
for sig in (signal.SIGPIPE, signal.SIGXFSZ):
    signal.signal(sig, signal.SIG_DFL)
try:
    os.execvp(argv[0], argv)
except OSError as e:
    sys.stderr.write("rpctl: cannot run %s: %s\n" % (argv[0], e))
    sys.exit(127)
